summary: Tested custom roles fix for Team Settings page. Backend endpoint GET /api/roles/{main_site_id}/available works correctly (10/10 tests passed). Frontend correctly displays dynamic roles including custom 'News Editor' and shows '(legacy)' indicator for legacy roles. However, CRITICAL BUG found: Changing a user's role to a custom role fails with 422 validation error because backend UpdateUserRoleRequest model uses hardcoded Literal instead of accepting any string role.

critical.issue: UpdateUserRoleRequest model in /app/backend/models/auth.py uses Literal['admin', 'news_admin', 'editor', 'presenter', 'viewer'] which rejects custom roles like 'news_editor'. Returns 422 validation error when trying to assign custom RBAC roles.
critical.fix: Change UpdateUserRoleRequest.role from Literal to str to accept any valid role slug from the RBAC system

ui_bugs.issue: When role update API returns 422 error, React crashes with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error instead of showing error toast

integration_issues.flow: Change user role to custom role
integration_issues.issue: Selecting a custom role from dropdown causes API 422 error and React crash
